title: Crate discrepancy
label: An open wooden crate full of shredded paper stands beside an empty pallet, and a packing slip is clipped to a board on the right. Six trays of tableware lift out of the crate one at a time. While each tray is in the air its line on the slip is highlighted; when it lands on the pallet the line gets the received count and a tick. The tray of serving bowls comes out with two of its twelve places empty: it glows amber and floats up above the pallet with a note reading Short by 2, Ordered 12 · received 10, joined by a dashed line to its row on the slip, which turns amber with a warning mark. The slip's total lands on 48 units matched and 1 discrepancy.
heading:
Every delivery,
checked line by line.
sub: Each item is matched to its purchase order as it comes out of the crate. Anything short, extra or wrong is flagged with a note for the supplier.
